goal: A dependable spatial playground in which Hadi can manipulate ideas and save discoveries.

acceptance.criterion: The house renders and both dollhouse and first-person joystick navigation can reach its rooms.
Create, reopen, edit and move an idea while preserving its contents.
Saved ideas reload correctly; a failed or conflicting save retains the draft and never overwrites newer data.
Room and door edits preserve ideas and reject invalid layouts.

Add one bounded Vertigo workbench with board editing and deterministic run/step/reset; verify small known cases and attach saved experiment state to an idea without losing old data.
